name: ultraglide-backend
description: UltraGlide simple backend service with Razorpay integration

scripts.build:lambda: rm -rf lambda-build && mkdir -p lambda-build && cp index.js app.js package.json lambda-build/ && cd lambda-build && npm install --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && rm -rf node_modules/better-sqlite3 node_modules/.cache && zip -r ../ultraglide-lambda.zip . && cd .. && echo '✅ Lambda ZIP ready: ultraglide-lambda.zip'
